channel: allcoredevs/_threads/Does it appear feasible to get Shorter
searchText: I'm just saying instead of pushing gas limit to 300m or higher as may be possible in Glamsterdam, maybe we instead do a more modest gas limit increase and reduce the slot time to 6s-8s in Hegotá. I think this is something the users of Ethereum really want to see. I do understand that lowering slot times raises the bar for other aspects of the roadmap, especially zkproving with lean Ethereum. However, I also think faster slot times will serve as a forcing function to encourage even more innovation to faster proving times on commodity GPUs.

excerpts.content:
I'm just saying instead of pushing gas limit to 300m or higher as may be possible in Glamsterdam, maybe we instead do a more modest gas limit increase and reduce the slot time to 6s-8s in Hegotá.  I think this is something the users of Ethereum really want to see. 

I do understand that lowering slot times raises the bar for other aspects of the roadmap,  especially zkproving with lean Ethereum.  However, I also think faster slot times will serve as a forcing function to encourage even more innovation to faster proving times on commodity GPUs.
